source_artifacts: Web Agent Architecture & Key Components course diagram

web_representation_model.course_concept: Transform webpage into an embedding/state representation before acting.
web_representation_model.hip_implementation: hip_id_agent.web_representation builds a value-free 256-dimensional signed-hash representation from DOM, accessibility, Angular/DDS component state, surface gate, DOM events/mutations, console categories, and network endpoint templates.

hierarchical_planner.course_concept: Decompose the user task into smaller browser tasks.
hierarchical_planner.hip_implementation: build_phase_task_plan creates one ordered task per state-graph node with dependencies and exact verification requirements.

action_model.course_concept: Predict and execute the next action from webpage and task context.
action_model.hip_implementation: HIPActionModel ranks only allow-listed actions through bounded UCB-style scoring, live binding evidence, and trajectory priors.

actor.hip_implementation: Playwright MCP is the primary actor; Python Playwright/DDS drivers provide exact component transactions. Chrome DevTools MCP independently observes the same authenticated tab.

critic.course_concept: Evaluate whether the action moved the browser toward the goal.
critic.hip_implementation: Every field transaction is critiqued using exact value, stable rerender, explicit event proof, child visibility, active-surface proof, validation, and committed-field mutation protection.

memory_personalization.course_concept: Use prior context and feedback to improve future action selection.
memory_personalization.hip_implementation: TrajectoryMemory stores value-free successful and failed state/action transitions and retrieves structurally similar cases. Existing flow-pattern memory reuses validated form topology across same-family phases.

mcts_agentq.course_concept: Explore/rank candidate action trajectories using AgentQ/MCTS-style search.
mcts_agentq.hip_implementation: Bounded UCB-style candidate ranking is applied per field. It is intentionally not an uncontrolled full-browser MCTS search.

preference_learning.course_concept: Learn a better action policy from preferred successful trajectories.
preference_learning.hip_implementation: Value-free winning/losing action preference pairs are written for optional future offline policy tuning. No online fine-tuning occurs during a portal run.

skills.hip_implementation: Universal form policies, flow-pattern memory, preferred control identities, and state-transaction blueprints act as validated reusable HIP skills.
skills.scope: all known HIP form families plus generic /hybrid-integrations fallback

mcp_servers.name: Playwright MCP
mcp_servers.role: safe semantic browser actor and accessibility snapshots

mcp_servers.name: Chrome DevTools MCP
mcp_servers.role: network, console, performance, DOM and low-level independent evidence

mcp_servers.name: HIP Intelligence MCP
mcp_servers.role: web representation, action planning, critic, drift and trajectory memory

multion.reason: The current agent already owns a persistent authenticated Chrome session. Adding MultiOn would introduce another browser/session/controller and conflict with single-SSO and exact-state guarantees.

safety_invariants: A memory prior cannot override active-form, one-to-one binding, validation, visibility, exact-value, or mutation gates.
Customer-entered values, credentials, tokens, authorization headers, and upload contents are excluded from trajectory memory.
A completed phase remains locked against judge-triggered browser replay.
